review_status: maintained engineering baseline; release review required
notice: Controls and tests reduce risk but do not qualify PySFMEA for certification credit or prove completeness on unseen repositories.

failure_modes.failure_mode: A relevant source or supporting artifact is silently omitted.
failure_modes.trigger: Exclusion, symlink, size, permission, path, file-count, unstable Python source, unstable repository artifact, unstable dependency manifest, ambiguous coverage evidence, or unstable/ambiguous interface-contract evidence is encountered.
effects: A reviewer may overestimate analysis coverage.
controls: Exact-byte identity-stable source, test-evidence, repository-artifact, dependency, coverage, and contract ingestion
Single-snapshot source/test/dependency/contract/coverage attribution, inventory evidence, and baseline binding
Strict structurally bounded contract JSON decoding
Source, test-evidence, dependency, coverage, contract, and repository inventory digests
verification: single-read source, test-evidence, dependency, contract, and coverage identity-race, replacement, encoding, limit, exclusion, inventory-reuse, and provenance tests
identity-stable repository-artifact hashing and bounded-consumption tests
dependency identity-race, recursive, limit, replacement, and provenance tests
coverage and contract ambiguity, overflow, structure, identity-race, replacement, external-boundary, limit, and provenance tests
failure_modes.residual_risk: Unsupported formats and dynamic/generated material still require project-specific analyzers or explicit manual review.

failure_modes.failure_mode: Python syntax is parsed incorrectly or a parse failure is represented as analyzed.
failure_modes.trigger: Unsupported syntax, encoding, malformed or concurrently replaced source, parser-version difference, or mismatch between parsed and baseline bytes.
effects: Components and source evidence may be missing or incorrectly localized.
verification: single-read source snapshot, identity-race, encoding, syntax-error, limit, and run-manifest tests
failure_modes.residual_risk: AST analysis cannot resolve runtime metaprogramming or interpreter-specific behavior.

failure_modes.failure_mode: A credible failure mode is missed or an irrelevant candidate is generated.
failure_modes.trigger: Rule coverage, source pattern, framework, or project domain differs from the validation corpus.
effects: False positives consume engineering review effort.
failure_modes.residual_risk: Real-world recall and precision are unknown outside curated cases; qualified review remains mandatory.

failure_modes.function: Maintain identity and review state across rescans
failure_modes.failure_mode: A review is attached to the wrong element or remains valid after a material change.
failure_modes.trigger: Rename, move, duplicate implementation, configuration change, dependency change, or ambiguous content fingerprint.
effects: Stale effects, controls, ratings, or approvals may be trusted.
verification: store rescan, move, ambiguity, and freshness tests
failure_modes.residual_risk: External behavior may change without a statically visible repository change.

failure_modes.failure_mode: A locator, revision, applicability profile, or rule relationship is wrong, stale, or leaks across domains.
failure_modes.trigger: Catalog update, mapping error, profile error, ambiguous JSON, input replacement, oversized structure, or malformed organizational pack.
effects: Reviewers may apply irrelevant guidance or misunderstand the authority of a finding.
verification: organizational pack ambiguity, overflow, structure, identity-race, and end-to-end tests
failure_modes.residual_risk: Document interpretation and legal/regulatory applicability remain human responsibilities.

failure_modes.function: Use an LLM for bounded discovery and summarization
failure_modes.failure_mode: Repository text overrides instructions, secrets escape, or unsupported claims are presented as facts.
failure_modes.trigger: Prompt injection, malicious strings, provider behavior, oversized content, or weak evidence linkage.
effects: False findings, fabricated effects/citations, data disclosure, or misplaced reviewer confidence.
verification: discovery schema, injection-string, secret-redaction, citation, and review tests
failure_modes.residual_risk: Third-party provider confidentiality and model behavior require organizational approval and independent review.

failure_modes.failure_mode: A proposed test lacks a real fault stimulus/oracle or a passing result is treated as verification.
failure_modes.trigger: Placeholder implementation, false-pass test, stale baseline, ambiguous or unstable assurance/evidence JSON, incomplete evidence, or same-person review.
effects: A control or failure response may appear verified without objective evidence.
verification: assurance queue/scaffold ambiguity and structure tests
failure_modes.residual_risk: Test adequacy and oracle correctness require domain expertise.

failure_modes.failure_mode: Untrusted repository code affects the host or escapes its approved boundary.
failure_modes.trigger: Container engine defect, unsafe image, mount/configuration error, excessive resources, credentials, or enabled network.
effects: Host, network, data, or credentials may be compromised.
failure_modes.residual_risk: Container isolation is not a perfect security boundary; high-risk repositories need stronger external sandboxes.

failure_modes.failure_mode: Repository-controlled content executes, corrupts a report, or produces unsafe spreadsheet/package behavior.
failure_modes.trigger: HTML/script text, spreadsheet formula prefix, path traversal, symlink, destination race, partial write, ZIP bomb, ambiguous/non-finite/oversized diagram JSON, or excessive custom diagram inputs.
effects: Reviewer workstation compromise, misleading report, or unsafe package extraction.
controls: Shared record-derived inventory metrics across HTML, coverage, inventory, and summary views
Strict exact-byte identity-stable custom diagram ingestion
Shared bounded identity-safe atomic artifact publication
failure_modes.residual_risk: Consumer software vulnerabilities and very large but permitted reports remain external risks.

failure_modes.failure_mode: Analysis or package bytes differ from recorded inputs while integrity checks still pass.
failure_modes.trigger: Digest omission, mutable manifest field, duplicate, non-finite, or overflowed numeric JSON, input identity swap, oversized structure, accepted source, dependency, coverage, or interface-contract snapshot omission, migration error, partial write, or verifier defect.
effects: Reviewers cannot reproduce or trust the claimed analysis baseline.
controls: Strict bounded identity-stable governed JSON ingestion
Source, dependency, coverage, and contract exact-byte provenance with immutable input binding
verification: manifest canonicalization, source/dependency/coverage/contract snapshot binding, inventory provenance/summary tamper detection, strict file/stream JSON ingestion, key/signature identity-change, envelope/manifest structure-bound, migration, atomicity, signing, and package-tamper tests
failure_modes.residual_risk: Hashes prove byte consistency, not authorship, authorization, semantic correctness, or long-term algorithm suitability.

failure_modes.function: Evaluate scanner behavior against a curated golden corpus
failure_modes.failure_mode: A malformed, changed, ambiguous, or adversarial evaluation baseline produces misleading quality metrics.
failure_modes.trigger: Linked or changing input, duplicate JSON/cases, oversized structure, unknown fields, ambiguous component identity, or unreviewed baseline revision.
effects: A release may cite recall or precision measured against the wrong corpus.
verification: test_evaluation.py adversarial ingestion and contract tests
failure_modes.residual_risk: A valid curated corpus can still be incomplete, biased, or incorrectly approved; independent baseline review remains required.

failure_modes.function: Import observed runtime topology and timing evidence
failure_modes.failure_mode: An incomplete, ambiguous, stale, malformed, or hostile trace produces misleading cascade or timing relationships.
failure_modes.trigger: Instrumentation gaps, sampling, duplicate JSON keys, non-finite values, input replacement, oversized structure, ambiguous component mapping, or an unrepresentative execution.
effects: A reviewer may infer a cascade path that was not reliably observed.
A real runtime dependency or timing failure may remain absent from the analysis.
verification: runtime ambiguity, numeric-overflow, structure, link, identity-race, mapping, idempotence, and rollback tests
failure_modes.residual_risk: A valid trace proves only what the selected instrumentation captured in that execution; coverage, clock quality, causality, and operational representativeness require independent review.
